effect: Privatising can raise a sector's efficiency above its day-0 level, and the gain reaches production. The efficiency target is (1 - f x share^2) / (1 - f x share0^2) without the cap of 1, bounded by the fully private level 1 / (1 - f x share0^2) (f = the game's sector factor: 0.22 tech/ict/knowledge, 0.16 trade/services, 0.12 industry, 0 health/education/public). The three later clamps to 1 are raised to 1.3, above the highest possible ceiling (1.28): the stored efficiency (qaQ), the per-sector map the economy reads (MrA, which now also passes values above 1), and the production factor; the save validator for the sector ownership record (AQB) accepts the same bound, so a gain survives save and reload; the player's ownership quote shows the current efficiency with the same bound. A tech sector 60% state-owned at day 0 gains up to about 8.6% output from full privatisation, approached at the game's own adjustment speed; nationalisation costs as before. Applies to AI privatisations too. Day 0 unchanged (share = share0 gives 1, and the map holds no entry for a factor of 1). (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
